description: Open source repositories that are in scope for active bug bounty programs, ordered by newest stable release first.

repos.name: googleapis/google-cloud-python
repos.description: Apache-2.0 licensed monorepo of idiomatic Python client libraries for Google Cloud APIs, holding more than 150 individually versioned packages (google-cloud-*, googleapis-common-protos, proto-plus, pandas-gbq, sqlalchemy-bigquery) that each publish their own GitHub release. In scope for the Google Open Source Software VRP on bughunters.google.com, whose current rules state that "the program covers all the latest versions of open source software stored in the public repositories of Google-owned GitHub organizations and selected repositories hosted on other platforms", googleapis being one of those organizations alongside google and GoogleCloudPlatform; repository configuration such as GitHub Actions workflows and access control rules is covered too. The repo is absent from Google's published OT0/OT1 tier manifest (google/bughunters oss-repository-tier/external_repositories.txtpb, 72 repos), so it sits in the standard tier where supply chain compromises pay $500-$3,133.7 and product vulnerabilities are reportable but not rewarded. Latest stable release: pandas-gbq-v0.35.1 (2026-08-06, 19:03 UTC), badged Latest by GitHub and not a pre-release.

repos.name: mozilla-conduit/lando
repos.description: MPL-2.0 licensed Python and Django web service that is Mozilla's automatic code-landing tool: it takes reviewed patches and applies and pushes them to Mozilla's Git and Mercurial repositories, including Firefox's, and now carries both the API and the UI that used to live in the legacy lando-api and lando-ui repositories. In scope for the Mozilla bug bounty on HackerOne (public, open for submissions, offers bounties, gold standard safe harbour) through the bounty-eligible asset lando.services.mozilla.com, rated critical maximum severity, whose scope entry names https://github.com/mozilla-conduit/lando as its source code and restricts live testing to the dev and stage instances ui.dev.lando.nonprod.cloudops.mozgcp.net and ui.stage.lando.nonprod.cloudops.mozgcp.net; the bounty is paid against the deployed service, so a code-level finding has to be shown to affect it, and low and medium severity reports are not eligible for any payout. Latest stable release: 2.64.0 (2026-08-06, 17:46 UTC).

repos.name: googleapis/google-cloud-ruby
repos.description: Apache-2.0 licensed monorepo of idiomatic Ruby client library gems for Google Cloud APIs, several hundred of them, the large majority generated by the GAPIC generator and each versioned and released separately. In scope for the Google Open Source Software VRP on bughunters.google.com under the same org-wide rule that covers every public repository in Google-owned GitHub organizations, googleapis included; like the Python monorepo it does not appear in Google's OT0/OT1 tier manifest and therefore falls in the standard tier, where supply chain compromises are the rewarded category ($500-$3,133.7) and product vulnerabilities are in scope to report but not to be paid. Latest stable release: google-cloud-security_center_management-v1/v1.8.1 (2026-08-06, 17:35 UTC), one of the several gem releases this repository publishes each day.
